hotel_name: Radisson Blu Towers Kaushambi Delhi Ncr

positive_snippets: A decent property with a great location. Hotel rooms were clean - a little tight but nice. Room service was timely and fairly tasty. Staff were great. They afforded us with a wheelchair at no extra cost. Staff in general were very helpful. We did have a mishap with a delivery being refused but I had not checked in despite having advised them by email and phone. 1 of out 2 deliveries made it. This hotel is wedding central so that energy was nice but could grate on you after awhile not to mention the chaos of the parking lot.

Nitish was a wonderful staff at the restaurant.

I loved the buffet for the night, and the staff were really helpful when I needed internet and the signal was choppy, they allowed me to patch into their internet!

The dinner buffet was great, and all you can drink chai was great too.

Rooms were passable, clean but bare no what we expected for a suite. But very clean and presentable,

The showers were hot and water pressure was great.

Had a wonderful stay at Radisson Blu Towers. The rooms were very clean and hygienic, which instantly made the stay comfortable. The staff was quick, professional, and always ready to help with a smile. Breakfast was a highlight — great taste and a wide variety of dishes to choose from specially mentioned to Mr Nitish
He is very humble person. Overall, the hospitality was excellent and the team was very polite and cooperative. Highly recommended for a comfortable and hassle-free stay.
